author: Staff
title: Softball: Biracree strikes out 12 as Le Roy defeats Letchworth 7-3 - NewsBreak
text:
By Staff ,
5 hours ago Bryar Biracree struck out 12 batters and allowed just two hits to lead Le Roy to a 7-3 divisional victory over Letchworth on Tuesday.
​Biracree also contributed offensively, driving in two runs. The Knights pulled away in the late innings, highlighted by a two-RBI performance from Annora Karcher in the sixth.
​Lila Fortes finished the day with two hits and two RBIs for Le Roy. Kylie Wilson went 2-for-4 and scored two runs, while Izzy Farrell added an RBI in the win.
​Kendall Jines pitched for Letchworth, recording 12 strikeouts in the loss.
WP: Bryar Biracree (12 K, 2 H)
LP: Kendall Jines (12 K)
